tests.reason: The case fixes price and discount_percent as create-time fields, so the item must be created via POST /api/v1/items/ with those values, and that POST must be the last data-carrying request. But REQUEST says auth is false, so the request under test would be sent with token=None, and the create route needs credentials. Creating a priced item anonymously is impossible with these tools. make.item() has no price field, and PUT also needs a token. No factory or route provides an anonymous path, so the final_price value cannot be produced and observed as required.

The case requires an empty JSON object on PUT, but CASE_DATA fixes price '10.00' and discount_percent 15, and the rules require the request under test to carry every key in data exactly. Sending data would make it a non-empty update, and sending {} would violate the data rule. The case cannot be bound as specified.
